name: Epson Scan 2
tagline: Software for Epson scanners & multifunction printer
blurb: Epson Scan 2 is a scanning application for Epson scanner.
description:
Epson Scan 2 is a scanning application for Epson scanner. It
allows to set various scanner settings with graphical user
interface and save the scanned images to the various file
type.

It supports USB, and network connection for the network capable
scanners.

Scanners can also be controlled with the command line.

While the application is Free Software, the scanner drivers
contains Proprietary components.

This build is not supported by Epson Seiko Corporation, and is provided as is.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
